dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Life can be as precious as jade if you dig past the rocky exterior. Make acute, quick decisions in life, or you will regret missed opportunities.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: But while we only live once, we can enjoy the joy of jade many-a-time. Which is more exciting, embarking on a daring adventure or receiving a beautiful piece of jade?

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Just a small price for a big surprise.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Delights and good luck await you at The Jade Mystery!

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: A cartload of uncut jade has just arrived. Come by to marvel its beauty, and purchase if so inclined!
